normalized.result:
This is looking really lovely — the layout, the collections, favorites, unread filter, search, and the edit/delete controls all feel like what I wanted for keeping my links organized. That side of it I'm happy with.

One thing stops me from calling it done, though. When I went to add a bookmark, it made me type in the title and the description myself. What I really expected is that I just paste the link and the app goes and grabs the page's name and description (and its little icon) for me automatically — that's the whole point of quickly saving something I stumble across. Having to fill all that in by hand defeats the convenience.

Could you make it so that saving a link pulls in the page's title and description on its own, and I can tweak them if I want? Once adding a link is that quick, I think this is basically what I was after.
